caption: The drawing features a central brown animal resembling a cat or dog, facing left. To the left of the animal is a large pink circle. To the right of the animal is a stylized green tree with evenly spaced horizontal branches, and the top points upward. There are four diamond-shaped forms with brown outlines and blue centers placed at the upper right, lower left, and lower right corners, as well as near the top right of the image. Surrounding these objects are several short, pink, curved marks scattered throughout the background. At the top left and below the animal are sets of horizontal lines, with three thick dark blue lines interspersed with two lighter blue lines. The background is beige, and there is some green handwritten text in the top left corner. The composition is symmetrical with geometric and stylized elements distributed evenly across the page.
title: Bedspread
